disclaimer: Hypothetical learning scenarios only. Not live market data, investment research, personalised advice, or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any security.

scenarios.label: Bullish condition
scenarios.title: Continuation after strength
scenarios.hypothesis: If price holds above a previously observed swing area and participation expands, continuation is one possible scenario to study.
observe: Whether a breakout holds on a retest
scenarios.invalidation: Price falls back into the prior range or the higher-low structure fails.
scenarios.question: Was the move confirmed, or did you react to one candle?

scenarios.label: Range / base case
scenarios.title: Two-sided consolidation
scenarios.hypothesis: If price remains inside a defined range without sustained acceptance beyond either boundary, consolidation is one possible scenario to study.
scenarios.invalidation: A confirmed expansion and sustained close outside the range.
scenarios.question: Is there a clear setup, or is patience the better lesson?

scenarios.label: Bearish condition
scenarios.title: Failed support / lower high
scenarios.hypothesis: If price loses a previously observed support zone and a recovery forms a lower high, downside continuation is one possible scenario to study; the pattern can fail.
scenarios.invalidation: Price reclaims the broken area and restores prior structure.
scenarios.question: Where would the original thesis be demonstrably wrong?
